marta: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A. Capture top win/loss signals and concrete asks for leadership.

raj: Sales: lost 2 deals because private deployment setup took too long; buyers wanted managed VPC connector.

alisa: CS: wins were observability dashboard and per-route cost view. Renewals cited those.

devin: Eng: recurring ask = single terraform module + network checklist for Private.

nico: Product ask: fallback policy visibility and fallback logs; customers want opt-in behavior.

raj: Sales needs a 1-pager on data residency/KMS/audit logs for infra teams (ready in 3 weeks).

marta: Action items: private quickstart (DevEx+devin) 3w; security 1-pager (security+alisa) 2w; cost-calc prototype (product+devin) 2w. I will create tickets.
